headline: 3 suspects detained as police solve mystery behind Comilla teenager's murder
summary: Ishayat Shahriyar Opratim, the son of a Comilla University teacher, was found dead on a hillock after going missing for two days
details: Ishayat Shahriyar Opratim, a seventh-grade student of Comilla Border Guard School, was found dead on a hillock behind Magic Paradise Park near Comilla University on Saturday.
Opratim had gone missing on Friday afternoon after leaving home with his mother's iPhone to take photos with friends at Shalbon Bihar.
Following a general diary (GD) filed by his mother, Nahida Begum, an Associate Professor at Comilla University's Bengali Department, police began a search.
Three suspects, including a youth named Tuhin, were detained based on CCTV footage. Two others, Fahim and and Anas, were later arrested following interrogation of the first suspect.
Police recovered Opratim's missing iPhone from the home of the detained suspect Tuhin, a fact confirmed by Tuhin's mother.
The first janaza prayer for Opratim was held at the Comilla University field on Sunday morning, followed by his burial in the South Bagmara Kotbari area.
caption:
A 7th grader's missing iPhone led police to three suspects in the case of the murder of a university teacher's son.

Ishayat Shahriyar Opratim, a seventh-grade student of Comilla Border Guard School, was found dead on a hillock behind Magic Paradise Park near Comilla University on Saturday.

Opratim had gone missing on Friday afternoon after leaving home with his mother's iPhone to take photos with friends at Shalbon Bihar.

Following a general diary (GD) filed by his mother, Nahida Begum, an Associate Professor at Comilla University's Bengali Department, police began a search.

Three suspects, including a youth named Tuhin, were detained based on CCTV footage. Two others, Fahim and and Anas, were later arrested following interrogation of the first suspect.

Police recovered Opratim's missing iPhone from the home of the detained suspect Tuhin, a fact confirmed by Tuhin's mother.

The first janaza prayer for Opratim was held at the Comilla University field on Sunday morning, followed by his burial in the South Bagmara Kotbari area.

#Comilla #JusticeForOpratim #Bangladesh #CrimeNews #CrimeInvestigation

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo, The Daily Star

headline_marked: DNCC identifies [[100 dengue hotspots in North Dhaka]], DSCC marks 29 risky wards
headline: DNCC identifies 100 dengue hotspots in North Dhaka, DSCC marks 29 risky wards
summary: Authorities have launched special cleanup drives to destroy Aedes mosquito larvae in high-risk areas across the capital.
details: The Dhaka North City Corporation (DNCC) has identified 100 dengue hotspots based on the addresses of hospitalized patients. These areas are seeing a high density of infections, prompting targeted mosquito eradication efforts.
caption:
100 hotspots in North Dhaka and 29 high-risk wards in South Dhaka. The fight against dengue intensifies.

The Dhaka North City Corporation (DNCC) has identified 100 dengue hotspots based on the addresses of hospitalized patients. These areas are seeing a high density of infections, prompting targeted mosquito eradication efforts.
